_regions.R: scarlet plumage: crown, nape, throat, breast, belly, mantle and the red lesser wing coverts
_regions.r: shadow line on the wing's leading edge, from the back edge at the shoulder (7,6) down to the band (12,11), separating the folded wing from the breast
_regions.G: green tips of the yellow coverts, the scalloped lower edge of the band
_regions.B: blue flight feathers (secondaries/primaries), ending at the perch
_regions.T: red tail (long central tail feathers), red to the tip
_regions.t: blue outer tail feathers along the tail's upper edge, stopping one row above the red tip
_regions.W: bare white face patch; it encloses the eye on all 8 sides
_regions.u: mid-horn front edge and hook tip of the upper mandible, so the beak profile holds on a light background
_regions.L: black lower mandible (2x2), drawn dark slate so it never reads as a hole
_regions.F: dark grey foot: a solid 2 px foot on top of the perch, under the belly, with one claw pixel over the perch's front
